catalog.title: Travel catalog

modal.title: Departure settings

inquiries.title: Travel inquiries

support.title: Support
support.description: Notices, FAQs and private questions run on G7 boards.

questions.title: Private questions
questions.description: Secret questions visible only to the author and admins. Answer with comments.
